desc: Baja California based duo -- vocalist / lyricist Ingrid León and multi-instrumentalist / composer Bob James -- evoke a classic, traditional and retro vibe with these Regional Mexican songs about friendship, love, longing, motherhood and freedom.

tracks.desc: This beautiful and grateful ode to mothers gives thanks for all her love, guidance and support. Themes of appreciation, longing, remembrance and guidance in relation to being a daughter or son are supported by featured performances on acoustic guitar, guitarrón (Mexican acoustic bass), vihuela (Mexican acoustic tenor guitar), harp, trumpet and violins. Perfect for Mother's Day and family holiday themed scenes.

A sincere and appreciative homage to friendship, and all the value in being there for someone. Themes of nostalgia, longing, remembrance and affection in regards to platonic relationships are supported by featured performances on acoustic guitar, guitarrón (Mexican acoustic bass), vihuela (Mexican acoustic tenor guitar), harp, trumpet and violins. Perfect for buddy films and girls-night-out themed scenes.

Up tempo Regional Mexican song about not being forgotten, romantic relatioships and calling out to a long lost lover. Features performances on accordion, acoustic guitar, guitarrón (Mexican acoustic bass), vihuela (Mexican acoustic tenor guitar), harp and trumpet. Good for telenovelas, family dramas and romance themed episodes.

Humorous, playful and up-tempo song about breaking free and not staying at home all the time. Themes of liberty, freedom, women's rights and rebellion are supported by featured performances on acoustic guitar, vihuela (Mexican acoustic tenor guitar), harp, trumpet and violins. Perfect for scenes about women's liberation, lady power and doing what I want.

Sensual and romantic ode to falling in love, where the sun, moon and the sea move you to look into my lips, so you can tell me you feel the same way I do. Features performances on accordion, acoustic guitar, guitarrón (Mexican acoustic bass), vihuela (Mexican acoustic tenor guitar), harp, and trumpet. Good for telenovelas, period films and romance themed episodes.
